name: Rustic Montana Furniture
old_description: Your source for authentic, elegantly western furniture.  Made in Montana, you can be assured each piece is created to last a lifetime.  All of our beds are true mortise and tenon construction.   Transform your home with handcrafted authentic western beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, and benches.  Created from barnwood or log, each are handcrafted with form and function in mind.  Our dining tables are all one-of-a-kind created with reclaimed lumber.  For your outdoor space we have rustic swings for two.  Rustic Montana Furniture is certified “Made in Montana”.
about:
Rustic Montana Furniture operates from Philipsburg, Montana, where it has been producing handcrafted western furniture for over two decades. The business is run by Walter Stanghill, who serves as the primary contact for the company. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm emphasizes its long-standing presence in the state and its commitment to local manufacturing.

The company designs and builds a range of solid-wood pieces including beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, benches, and outdoor swings. Every bed uses true mortise-and-tenon joinery, and dining tables are made from one-of-a-kind reclaimed lumber. Production is described as entirely handcrafted, with custom design services offered alongside standard product lines. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The firm markets directly to homeowners seeking authentic western aesthetics, positioning its work as heirloom-quality furniture for residential spaces. The website does not list specific commercial clients, interior-design accounts, or wholesale channels, so the primary customer base appears to be individual consumers.

Rustic Montana Furniture highlights its "Made in Montana" certification and its use of traditional mortise-and-tenon construction as key differentiators. The emphasis on reclaimed barnwood and log materials, along with the promise that each dining table is unique, frames the brand around authenticity and durability rather than mass production.

name: S and Y Industries, Inc.
old_description: Located in Winfield, Kansas, S and Y Industries has been one of America’s premier providers of custom electronics engineering, manufacturing and turnkey assembly services since 1984. As a family-owned, ISO-certified precision manufacturer, we strive to deliver unparalleled production consistency and efficiency with all of our premium electronics solutions.
about:
S and Y Industries, Inc. is based in Winfield, Kansas. The company was founded in 1984 by Sandy Foust on the back porch of a farmhouse in nearby Atlanta, Kansas. It remains a family-owned and woman-owned business, with Foust serving as CEO and her sons Dan and John Foust overseeing production operations and sales.

The firm provides custom electronics engineering, manufacturing, and turnkey assembly services. Its capabilities include printed circuit board (PCB) assembly using surface mount technology (SMT) and thru-hole processes, wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box-build integration, product test development, and functional testing. Operations run from a 60,000-square-foot facility staffed by more than 100 employees, supporting prototype through low- to mid-volume production runs.

Customers span the medical, aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company has supplied companies in these industries for over 35 years, delivering precision electronic assemblies and complete box-build solutions.

S and Y Industries emphasizes a family-like culture, stating that "people who care about where they work make better products." The leadership describes its approach as acting as a seamless extension of the customer's operation, aiming to provide what the customer wants, when they want it, without unnecessary questions.

name: S&F Foods, Inc.
old_description: Manufacturing for institutional school foodservice programs and retail since 2003.
about:
S&F Foods, Inc. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Romulus, Michigan, a suburb of Detroit. The company began as a manufacturer focused on institutional school foodservice programs and retail channels, producing a variety of enrobed and topped frozen items.

The company operates a 37,000-square-foot food manufacturing facility capable of handling both high and low production volumes. Its processing lines include an enrobed line for filling and par-baking hand-held pocket-style items, a topped line for par-baking crusts of various sizes, and individually quick frozen (IQF) capabilities. The facility also offers gluten-free manufacturing with segregated storage and a dedicated processing line, along with multiple packing options such as printed film, retail boxes, and cartons.

S&F Foods serves institutional school foodservice programs, retail distributors, and the National School Lunch Program across the United States. It also participates in USDA Commodity Processing for cheese, tomato paste, and flour. Signature products include the Original “Pull-A-Part” Topped Breadsticks and Dave’s Detroit Style Pizza™.

The company emphasizes food safety and quality, holding BRCGS AA Grade certification, GFCO gluten-free certification, and organic certification through the Global Organic Alliance. Its mission highlights a commitment to producing safe, certified, and authentic products, supported by in-house and external allergen testing and ongoing review of its Food Safety & Quality Policy.

name: S&W Foods
old_description: S&W Wholesale was founded in 1978 by Frank & Rosemary Spalitta, lifelong residents of Hammond, Louisiana. They began with a passion for serving local foodservice operators throughout Tangipahoa Parish. Today their son, Paul, continues to grow and build on their legacy by servicing throughout all of Southeast Louisiana and the Mississippi Gulfcoast.
about:
S&W Foods, operating as S&W Wholesale, was founded in 1978 by Frank and Rosemary Spalitta in Hammond, Louisiana. The family-owned business began with a focus on serving foodservice operators throughout Tangipahoa Parish. Today, the company is led by their son, Paul Spalitta, representing second-generation ownership with a third generation emerging.

The company functions as a broadline distributor, supplying a wide range of food and non-food items including produce, meats, breads, condiments, equipment, smallwares, paper goods, and cleaning supplies. Its distribution facility is located near the I-55/I-12 corridor, enabling rapid delivery across southeast Louisiana and the Mississippi Gulf Coast. S&W maintains private-label brands such as Copper Creek Cattle Company and Captain Frank's Seafood, and partners with major suppliers including Unipro Foodservice, Campbell Foodservice, ConAgra Foodservice, Rich Products Corporation, Pillsbury, Hormel, General Mills, and Smithfield Foods.

S&W serves a diverse customer base of independent and chain restaurants, including donut shops, coffee shops, Tex-Mex, Italian, Mediterranean, family dining, sandwich shops, and seafood establishments. The company emphasizes personal relationships and quick response times, noting it remained operational and made deliveries the day after Hurricanes Ida and Katrina when other distributors could not.

The company's guiding principle, coined by the founder, is "Large enough to serve, small enough to care." S&W differentiates itself through independent ownership that allows flexibility without corporate red tape, a commitment to knowing customers by name, and specialized programs such as custom-cut steaks, fresh produce sourcing through Fresh Concepts, and artisanal cheeses via The Rind Cheese Company.

name: SAI Advanced Power Solutions
old_description: Introducing Profusion™ - a revolutionary all-in-one PDU platform with one of the best industry lead times, quality, and performance. It features a sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and power distribution cabinet with advanced metering and monitoring, accessible locally and remotely.
about:
SAI Advanced Power Solutions is headquartered in Franklin Park, Illinois, with additional campuses in St. Charles and a distribution center in Carol Stream. The company operates as an end-to-end manufacturer of advanced power distribution solutions, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and builds low-voltage switchgear (UL 1558, UL 891), medium-voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, DC switchgear, and custom power distribution units (PDUs). Its product portfolio includes the Profusion™ all-in-one PDU platform with sectionalized main disconnect, K-rated transformer, and integrated metering, as well as the EVention™ platform for EV charging infrastructure compliant with BABA standards. SAI also provides engineering, design, system optimization, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and power quality monitoring services. A new production center, three times the size of its previous facility, supports both custom and high-volume manufacturing.

SAI serves customers in telecommunications, renewable energy integration, hydrogen energy generation, battery energy storage systems, and energy consulting. Its market-focused business units target mission-critical facilities, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), commercial/industrial/government accounts, emerging markets, and after-market support.

name: SFS Fabrication
old_description: Specialty Fabrication Services is a family owned and operated full-service metal fabrication shop built upon the aptitude of motivated people who believe that teamwork and continuous improvement is essential to providing quality products and services for our valued customers.
about:
Specialty Fabrication Services, operating as SFS Fabrication, is a family-owned and operated metal fabrication shop based in Taylor, Michigan. The company does not disclose a founding year, but notes more than 40 years of combined experience among its staff. It began as a full-service shop built on teamwork and continuous improvement.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication across tubular and sheet metal work, including welding (TIG, MIG, soldering), metal shearing (up to 1/4" x 4ft and 3/16" x 10ft), press brake forming (24 gauge to 1 inch), roll cones (1.5" to 20" OD), tube forming, custom exhaust, sheet metal stamping, laser cutting, waterjet cutting, machining, and finishing services such as painting, powder coating, bead blasting, plating, annealing, and hardening. Equipment includes a 10-foot press brake, 10-foot hydraulic shear, 200-ton hydraulic four-post press, Huth tube expander and bender, Bridgeport mills, lathes, bandsaws, and cold saws. The facility handles projects from prototype development through production runs.

SFS serves industrial, manufacturing, medical, food processing, residential/commercial, automotive, and crematorium sectors. Typical projects include production brackets, riser assemblies, catalyst adapters, food-grade conveyors, catwalks, machine guards, frames, and custom fixturing. The shop works with stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, mild steel, and cast iron.

The company emphasizes integrity, ethical practices, responsiveness, and fair pricing, aiming to build long-term partnerships. It welcomes walk-in customers for estimates and stresses on-time, on-budget delivery.

name: SMC Electrical Products
old_description: Becker/SMC was originally established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. From the beginning, Becker/SMC focused on quality products and service to meet customers’ needs. Becker/SMC designs and manufactures electrical components, open-type and explosion proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls and power distribution equipment for a variety of industries.
about:
Becker/SMC was established in 1971 in Huntington, West Virginia. The company, now based in Bristol, Virginia, operates over 90,000 square feet of manufacturing space. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures electrical components including open-type and explosion-proof motor starters, longwall electrical controls, power distribution equipment, transformers, vacuum switches, connectors, and electronic monitoring devices. A Custom Equipment Operation uses parametric engineering and lean manufacturing to turn customer specifications into precision products. The facility employs a skilled workforce that follows strict quality assurance protocols.

Becker/SMC serves a variety of industries, with a notable presence in the transit sector following the acquisition of OB Systems. OB Systems’ rectifiers, AC and DC switchgear, traction power substations, and trolley hardware are supplied to heavy and light rail systems across North America. The company also supports mining operations with longwall controls and provides power distribution for general industrial applications.

The company emphasizes its role as an innovator, stating that most major innovations and specialized electrical components have been developed in-house.

name: SPI Solar Panel Installation NC
old_description: We have helped hundreds of North Carolina homeowners cut their energy bills and protect their homes with professional solar installations and roofing built to last. Certified experts, transparent pricing, and a guarantee that protects your investment for 25 years.
about:
Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, SPI Solar Panel Installation NC is a locally owned and operated solar and roofing contractor that has served homeowners across the state for more than ten years. The company was founded by a team of certified installers who recognized that many North Carolina residents were being approached by out-of-state firms that relied on subcontractors and offered little ongoing support.

The firm provides a full suite of residential energy services, including custom rooftop solar design and installation, solar panel repair, complete roof installation, repair and inspection, home battery storage, electric vehicle charger installation, solar-powered heat pumps, home insulation and sealing, and solar shading systems. All work is performed by the company’s own crews, with no subcontractors, and the company reports having installed systems for hundreds of homeowners, collectively generating over 25 million kilowatt-hours of clean energy annually.

Its customer base consists exclusively of residential property owners throughout North Carolina, from coastal regions to the mountains. The company tailors each project to the home’s specific energy usage, roof condition, and local utility requirements, and also assists with permitting and utility interconnection paperwork.

The founders started the business to address what they saw as a gap in the market: out-of-state solar and roofing companies making large promises, sending subcontractors, and disappearing after installation. SPI differentiates itself by using only certified local installers, offering transparent pricing, a 25-year performance guarantee, free home assessments, and dedicated aftercare support for the life of the system.
